QuestInfo.name: The Egg Is Mine
QuestInfo.0: No one cared more about the safety of eggs than Yaku, but he seemed worried. Alpha and Beta decided to find out why. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: Yaku is nervous about Ito lingering around the egg. Go ask #bIto#k why it is lingering around the egg.
QuestInfo.2: Neither Yaku nor Ito wanted to give up the egg. Alpha and Beta decided to ask Corba for advice.

0.0: C-careful! That egg is EXTREMELY delicate, especially since it's going to hatch soon!
0.1: Ugh, I feel so on edge! #bIto#k is constantly wandering around that egg... I think he's up to something. His pranks have cracked eggs before!
0.2: Can you find out exactly what #bIto#k is up to?

yes.0: I need to know if #bIto#k is planning on pulling a prank right away.

no.0: #BITO#K WILL PAY if ANYTHING happens to that egg!

npc.0: What prank is #bIto#k going to pull? I smell trouble, oh yes. Find out what #bIto#k is up to!
